description:
modules/workforce — GET /traeger/staff-records/{id}/time-account (#4711,
ADR 0242) at a Träger with two schools: the Träger's schools, the binding of
the Träger transaction, its release, the record and its links in one
statement each; then per school the binding of its tenant transaction, the
staff the Träger closes, the closed months, and the Monatskarte of the
school (snapshots, settings, closing days, overrides, profile, schedules,
sessions, breaks, absences, shifts, adjustments). Flat in the number of
months and bookings; one tenant transaction per school (ADR 0105).
